# Heartbeat of South Bay

> AI Revenue Systems for service-based businesses: capture leads, automate follow-up, and convert more opportunities into customers.

Heartbeat of South Bay builds AI-powered systems — lead capture, instant follow-up, CRM integration, and reporting — for local service businesses. Based in the South Bay (Los Angeles), serving the United States.
